description: This file contains mock class definitions for the IMediaPipeline and IMediaPipelineFactory interfaces, used for unit testing media pipeline components in the Rialto project. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for testing interactions.

classes.name: MediaPipelineFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IMediaPipelineFactory interface, used to create mock media pipeline objects in tests.

classes.name: MediaPipelineMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IMediaPipeline interface, providing mock implementations of media pipeline methods for testing.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Creates a mock media pipeline instance with specified client and video requirements.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the media pipeline client.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media of a specified type, MIME type, and URL.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the pipeline.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source by its ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video window position and size.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Checks if data is available for a given status and request ID.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to the pipeline.
